name: patch_low_1
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,sys
src=open('src/ZeckLow.lean').read()
o="      simp [doSplit, h1, h2]\n    have e : z + W q 0 (c1 + 2) 0 c3 0 0"
assert o in src
src=src.replace(o,"      simp [doSplit, h1, h2, show q ≠ 0 by omega]\n    have e : z + W q 0 (c1 + 2) 0 c3 0 0",1)
o="    simp only [D_add, D_W, D_single, zero_add]\n    have hD0 : D 0 = 0 := by simp [D]\n    rw [hD0]\n    nlinarith [hd]"
assert o in src
src=src.replace(o,"    simp only [D_add, D_W, D_single, zero_add]\n    nlinarith [hd]")
o="    rw [ev, h1]\n    simp\n    omega\n"
assert src.count(o)==2,src.count(o)
src=src.replace(o,"    rw [ev, h1]\n    simp\n")
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','write_lane.py','src/ZeckLow.lean'],input=src,text=True,capture_output=True)
print(r.returncode,r.stderr)
